scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: What do you do when you wake up in the morning?
Priya says: Instagram.
Priya says: Before going to sleep at night?
Priya says: Reels.
Priya says: In between?
Priya says: Again, Reels.
Priya says: You spend four hours a day scrolling, but you can't find fifteen minutes to actually speak English?
Priya says: That is exactly why you still freeze when it's time to talk.
Priya says: I'm not saying don't use your phone.
Priya says: Just take fifteen minutes out of those four hours.
Priya says: Download the Supernova AI app.

- Hook: Blunt, tough-love behavioral critique about wasting time on social media.
- Emotion: Urgency and self-reflection.
- Payload: Names English early, introduces the negative time anchor (Reels/scrolling).

Priya says: Make a thousand mistakes at midnight. She will correct you instantly and never laugh at you.
Priya says: Plus, she explains the logic in Hindi, so you never feel lost.
Priya says: You learned your native language by speaking it, and English works the exact same way.
Priya says: Stop saying you'll do it later.
